## About Jayesh Soni
Jayesh Soni is a Product Lead and AI Product Designer based in 2026. He shapes how intelligent systems interact with humans, translating complex multi-agent architectures into intuitive, trust-inspiring software products.

- **Title**: Product Lead • AI Product Designer
- **Tagline**: Designing AI products that align human behaviour, business goals, and intelligent agents.
- **Website**: https://jayeshsoni.com
- **LinkedIn**: https://www.linkedin.com/in/jayeshsoni31/
- **Email**: jayeshsoni31@gmail.com
- **Resume**: https://jayeshsoni.com/resume.pdf

### Selected Impact
- Drove Allyra.ai’s shift from an agent-building tool to an organisation-ready enterprise AI platform.
- Designed interaction patterns and task-focused, human-in-the-loop workflows for 19+ AI agents.
- Expanded Allyra's reach across 15+ organisations, including Fortune 500 conglomerate pilots, through platform usage and API integrations.
- Led a team of 3 designers and 2 business analysts; boosted design throughput from ~1 to 2–3 features per designer/week.
- Designed workflow automation for Tulah, a wellness and hospitality platform, replacing fragmented spreadsheets and forms with connected digital workflows.
- Delivered operational product experiences for Stanford Medicine, including the Financial Aid app.
- Speaker at TiE Chandigarh on AI and Human-Centred Design.

## Detailed Case Study 1: Allyra.ai
- **URL**: https://jayeshsoni.com/allyra-story
- **Title**: Scaling AI from Individual Agents to Enterprise-Grade Workflows
- **Role**: Product Lead • AI Product Designer
- **Team**: Led 3 designers and 2 business analysts
- **Summary**: Allyra.ai solves the fundamental challenge of moving enterprise AI beyond single point-solution chatbots into unified, multi-agent workflows.

### Key Milestones & Contributions
- **Agent Governance & Portal Dashboard**: Centralized control centers for monitoring agent activities, compliance, and enterprise data permissions.
- **Workflow Composite Engine**: Visual and natural-language workflow builders for enterprise teams to chain AI agents together.
- **Outcome Validation**: Deployed across 15+ organisations, including Fortune 500 conglomerate pilots, with 19+ specialized AI agents and human-in-the-loop approvals.

---

## Detailed Case Study 2: Campaign OS
- **URL**: https://jayeshsoni.com/campaign-os-story
- **Title**: Autonomous Campaign Operating System & Conversational Analytics
- **Role**: Product Lead
- **Summary**: Campaign OS unifies campaign planning, execution, and optimization into a single collaborative workspace where AI acts as an active marketing partner.

### Key Features
- **Connected Workflows**: Unified campaign lifecycle on a continuous canvas.
- **Conversational Analytics**: Interactive AI dialogues explaining the "why" behind performance metrics.
- **Living Insights**: Modular AI insight blocks remixable across marketing teams.
- **Calm Monitoring**: Autonomous background alerts that surface only when human decision-making is strictly required.
